note: Signed relational comparison. CURRENTLY FAILS, DELIBERATELY, on hif-backend#81: with `signed` dropped from the ports the comparison is unsigned, so every pair with exactly one negative operand inverts - -1 < 1 is true signed and false unsigned, because 4'b1111 is 15. Kept separate from signed_add because the relational operators are different code in the emitter and the failure looks different: a boolean that is simply the wrong way round rather than a number that is far out. Carries controls - eq, and a two-negatives row - that read the same either way.
